A Rishi, brother of Vasishtha and son of Mitra and Varuna;^* he is called Maitravaruni (“son of Mitra and Varuna”) and Kumbhayoni (“born in a jar”) (see below); he once saw his ancestors hanging in a cave, and was urged by them to procure progeny; he then from the most beautiful parts of all animals created Lopamudra and let her become the daughter of the king of Vidarbha; when he had married her he, in order to procure riches for her, applied successively to three kings, and then to the Danava Ilvala, who shaped his own younger brother into a he-goat that was digested by Agastya. Agastya had a son by Lopamudra named Dridhasyu or Idhmavaha.
